name: Warrenton
story: At Warrenton, a railway bridge crosses the Vaal and the story turns toward Northern Cape farming, diamond fields and community arts.
history: Northern Cape Tourism traces the town to an 1880 irrigation venture supplying vegetables to the diamond fields.

experience.activity: Discover local creative work at the Ditshoswane Community Art Centre, subject to current visitor arrangements.
